title: Waterway Letter Ride
hook: Say the word, then paddle again.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat of silence before confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D lakes-and-waterways storybook, canoe-map adventure mood, teal-green palette, toy-like clarity

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: paddling guide moving across lakes, channels and river bends
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written paddle-song clues using short internal answer-rhymes, slant rhyme, and irregular open lines; rare names deliberately remain unrhymed
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: one-beat silence, target answer, then compact gesture; hard names slow down
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 banjo plucks stay sparse; chorus adds clap; Round 2 uses bass/wood pulse with whistle only between answers
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: single banjo pluck pickup plus tiny whistle response
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn the alphabet into a paddle route where every bend creates anticipation: pause, look, name what appears, then move on. The recurring pleasure is discovery around the next turn.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: Route language—bend, reach, bank, channel, paddle, pause, again—plus compact answer-rhymes that behave like instrumental replies. The narrator is a calm guide in a moving boat, not a static picture-book host.
semanticArc: move through bends and shallow reaches
paddles rest after the final turn
